title: Divorce Attorney Google Ads: County-Level Case Value

facts.fact: Segarra & Associates, P.A. ran $2,500 a month on Google Ads across Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach, producing about 50 leads a month at roughly $50 each (vendor case study).
facts.quote: ran $2,500 a month across Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach, producing about 50 leads a month at roughly $50 each

facts.fact: The Segarra & Associates engagement with the vendor lasted 1 year at $2,500 per month.
The vendor's Segarra case study reports about 50 leads a month, made up of roughly 30 phone calls and 20 contact forms.
The vendor's Segarra case study reports a cost per lead of roughly $50 on a $2,500 monthly budget.
In the Segarra case study, about 60% of leads arrived by phone and 40% by contact form.
facts.quote: Sixty percent of leads came by phone and forty percent by form

facts.fact: In the Segarra case study, roughly 30 leads came by phone call per month.
In the Segarra case study, roughly 20 leads came through contact forms per month.
The vendor set up a separate Google Ads campaign for each of the three counties (Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach) instead of one South Florida campaign.
facts.quote: Each county given its own campaign rather than one South Florida target.

facts.fact: The vendor states that Segarra's $2,500 monthly budget covers three of Florida's most populous counties.
facts.quote: $2,500 a month covering three of Florida's most populous counties

facts.fact: The vendor reports that the firm found matters originating in Palm Beach tended to involve clients with more substantial assets and more substantial cases, even though cost per lead was similar across counties.
facts.quote: matters originating in Palm Beach tended to involve clients with more substantial assets, and correspondingly more substantial cases

facts.fact: The vendor states that the firm's cost per lead was about $50 in each of the three counties, but case value differed by county as reported by the firm, not by the ad platform.
facts.quote: Those figures held reasonably steady across the three counties.
